Geographies Served Programs Special School for Kids with Intellectual Disabilities District Chengalpattu Chennai State Tamil Nadu District Chengalpattu Chennai States Tamil Nadu The Special School is designed to provide an educational environment that nurtures holistic development. We aim to equip students with the necessary life skills, academic knowledge, and vocational training to lead fulfilling lives, fostering their self-reliance, and integrating them into mainstream society. Programs/Activities at the school : - Individualized Education Plans (IEPs): These are customized educational maps developed for each child based on their abilities and needs. -Life Skills Training: Practical skills like personal hygiene, cooking, and basic household chores are taught to promote self-reliance. - Vocational Training: Older students receive training in trades or crafts, such as pottery, garland making enabling future opportunities. - Therapeutic Services: We provide physical therapy, speech therapy, and to address specific challenges faced by the students. - Extracurricular Activities, Social skills development and group interactions Adult M.R program District Chengalpattu Chennai State Tamil Nadu District Chengalpattu Chennai States Tamil Nadu The primary objective is to provide a safe, nurturing, and structured environment that caters to their unique needs. We aim to empower residents with skills, care, and opportunities to lead a life of dignity, enhancing their well-being and fostering greater societal integration. Activities : - Vocational Training: Tailored to individual capabilities, equips residents with skills in areas like handicrafts, gardening, and basic computer operations, preparing them for possible employment - Life Skills Development: emphasize self-care, personal hygiene, money management, and household chores to promote independence. - Recreational Activities: Art, music, dance, and sports activities are regularly organized to promote physical health, creativity, and emotional well-being. - Therapeutic Services: Depending on individual needs, physiotherapy and speech therapy are provided - Group interactions, outings to promote social interaction and confidence Milestones & Track Record Paradise Home has grown from humble beginnings in a rented building with just a couple of children to now caring for nearly 100 residents in their own facilities over the past 30 years. --> --> Leadership Team Mrs Mallika Gopal Founder Trustee Mr Ranga Reddy Founder Trustee Mr R V Gopal Trustee cum Secretary Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAATP5105B Registration Number v1000 p9074 823 CSR Form 1 CSR00013719 VO ID / Darpan ID TN/2018/0191837 --> 80G AAATP5105BF20211 12A AAATP5105BE19964 FCRA Not Available About Headquarters Chennai, Tamil Nadu Since 1991 Demographies Served Specially Abled --> Impact Paradise Home currently cares for 97 intellectually challenged individuals in their residential facilities, providing them with a safe, loving environment and opportunities to develop skills and independence. Vision and Mission The mission of Paradise Home is to help abused and neglected at-risk individuals with intellectual disabilities recover and flourish in a home-like setting where their value and self-esteem is realized and nourished.
